label: Process
name: Supplier Monitoring
purpose: Track and assess the performance of an external contract-based supplier against agreed commitments.

label: Process
name: Supplier Request and Selection
purpose: Select a supplier for a commitment/agreement based on relevant criteria.

label: Process
name: Product Release
purpose: Control the release of a product to the intended customer.

label: Process
name: Requirements Elicitation
purpose: Gather, analyze, and track evolving stakeholder needs and requirements throughout the lifecycle.

label: Process
name: System Requirements Analysis
purpose: Establish a structured and analyzed set of system requirements consistent with stakeholder requirements.

label: Process
name: System Architectural Design
purpose: Establish a system architectural design and identify which system requirements are to be allocated to which elements.

label: Process
name: System Integration and Integration Verification
purpose: Integrate the system elements and verify that the integrated system elements are consistent with the system architecture.

label: Process
name: System Verification
purpose: Confirm that the integrated system is consistent with the system requirements.

label: Process
name: Validation
purpose: Provide evidence that the end product satisfies the intended use expectations in its operational target environment.

label: Process
name: Software Requirements Analysis
purpose: Establish a structured and analyzed set of software requirements consistent with system requirements and system architecture.

label: Process
name: Software Architectural Design
purpose: Establish an analyzed software architecture consistent with the software requirements.

label: Process
name: Software Detailed Design and Unit Construction
purpose: Establish a software detailed design and construct software units consistent with the software detailed design.

label: Process
name: Software Unit Verification
purpose: Verify that software units are consistent with the software detailed design.

label: Process
name: Software Component Verification and Integration Verification
purpose: Verify that software components are consistent with the software architectural design and integrate the software elements.

label: Process
name: Software Verification
purpose: Confirm that the integrated software is consistent with the software requirements.

label: Process
name: Machine Learning Requirements Analysis
purpose: Refine the machine learning-related software requirements into a set of ML requirements.

label: Process
name: Machine Learning Architecture
purpose: Establish a ML architecture supporting training and deployment of a ML model consistent with ML requirements.

label: Process
name: Machine Learning Training
purpose: Optimize the ML model to meet the defined ML requirements.

label: Process
name: Machine Learning Model Testing
purpose: Ensure the compliance of the trained ML model and the deployed ML model with the ML requirements.

label: Process
name: Hardware Requirements Analysis
purpose: Establish a structured and analyzed set of hardware requirements consistent with system requirements.

label: Process
name: Hardware Design
purpose: Provide an analyzed design consistent with hardware requirements suitable for manufacturing.

label: Process
name: Verification against Hardware Design
purpose: Ensure that production data compliant hardware is verified for compliance with the hardware design.

label: Process
name: Verification against Hardware Requirements
purpose: Ensure that the complete hardware is verified to be consistent with the hardware requirements.

label: Process
name: Quality Assurance
purpose: Provide independent and objective assurance that work products and processes comply with defined criteria.

label: Process
name: Configuration Management
purpose: Establish and maintain the integrity of all identified work products of a process or project.

label: Process
name: Problem Resolution Management
purpose: Ensure that problems are identified, analyzed, managed, and controlled to resolution.

label: Process
name: Change Request Management
purpose: Ensure that change requests are managed, tracked, and implemented.

label: Process
name: Machine Learning Data Management
purpose: Ensure that ML data is managed and maintained throughout the ML lifecycle.

label: Process
name: Project Management
purpose: Identify, establish, and control the activities and resources necessary to produce a product.

label: Process
name: Risk Management
purpose: Continuously identify, analyze, treat, and monitor risks.

label: Process
name: Measurement
purpose: Collect, analyze, and report data relating to products and processes.

label: Process
name: Cybersecurity Risk Management
purpose: Regularly identify, analyze, prioritize, and monitor risks of damage to relevant stakeholders.

label: Process
name: Process Improvement
purpose: Continuously improve the effectiveness and efficiency of processes.

label: Process
name: Management of Products for Reuse
purpose: Ensure that reused work products are analyzed, verified, and approved for their target context.

label: Process
name: Cybersecurity Requirements Elicitation
purpose: Specify cybersecurity goals and requirements from outcomes of cybersecurity risk management.

label: Process
name: Cybersecurity Implementation
purpose: Refine the design of system, software and hardware consistent with cybersecurity requirements.

label: Process
name: Risk Treatment Verification
purpose: Confirm that implementation of design and integration of components comply with cybersecurity requirements.

label: Process
name: Risk Treatment Validation
purpose: Confirm that the integrated system achieves the associated cybersecurity goals.

label: CapabilityLevel
description: The process is not implemented or fails to achieve its process purpose.
name: Incomplete process

label: CapabilityLevel
description: The implemented process achieves its process purpose.
name: Performed process

label: CapabilityLevel
description: The performed process is now implemented in a managed fashion and its work products are appropriately established, controlled and maintained.
name: Managed process

label: CapabilityLevel
description: The managed process is now implemented using a defined process capable of achieving its process outcomes.
name: Established process

label: CapabilityLevel
description: The established process now operates predictively within defined limits to achieve its process outcomes.
name: Predictable process

label: CapabilityLevel
description: The predictable process is now continually improved to respond to organizational change.
name: Innovating process

label: ProcessAttribute
name: Process performance
scope_statement: A measure of the extent to which the process purpose is achieved.

label: ProcessAttribute
name: Process performance management
scope_statement: A measure of the extent to which the performance of the process is managed.

label: ProcessAttribute
name: Work product management
scope_statement: A measure of the extent to which the work products produced by the process are appropriately managed.

label: ProcessAttribute
name: Process definition
scope_statement: A measure of the extent to which a standard process is maintained to support the deployment of the defined process.

label: ProcessAttribute
name: Process deployment
scope_statement: A measure of the extent to which the standard process is deployed as a defined process to achieve its process outcomes.

label: ProcessAttribute
name: Quantitative analysis
scope_statement: A measure of the extent to which information needs are defined, relationships between process elements are identified and data are collected.

label: ProcessAttribute
name: Quantitative control
scope_statement: A measure of the extent to which objective data are used to manage process performance that is predictable.

label: ProcessAttribute
name: Process innovation
scope_statement: A measure of the extent to which changes to the process are identified from investigations of innovative approaches.

label: ProcessAttribute
name: Process innovation implementation
scope_statement: A measure of the extent to which changes to the definition, management and performance of the process achieves the relevant process innovation objectives.
